baseline.archiveNote: The baseline archive contains a selected set of source/config files, not a complete workspace snapshot.

comparison.method: SHA-256 content comparison by normalized relative path
comparison.classificationSemantics: created means present in the included current workspace and absent from the partial archive; it does not prove the file was first created during this patch.

created.note: Self-report path; hash intentionally omitted to avoid self-reference.

ambiguity: The backup archive is partial and omits entire areas such as public/ and docs/. Therefore files listed as created are strictly archive-absent, not necessarily newly introduced after the backup timestamp.
Changed and deleted classifications are exact for the 82 files represented by the archive.
The inventory report itself is included as created with no self-hash.
